主要内容: The Walt Disney Company approved amendments to its Restated Certificate of Incorporation at its annual meeting on March 3, 2016. The amendments became effective after being filed with the Delaware Secretary of State. The amendments are detailed in the proxy statement dated January 15, 2016, and are incorporated by reference. The final voting results showed that the election of directors and the ratification of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP received more votes 'for' than 'against.' The advisory vote on executive compensation and the amendments to the Restated Certificate of Incorporation were approved by more than a majority and more than two-thirds of shares, respectively. Two shareholder proposals, a simple majority vote and lobbying disclosure, failed due to lack of majority support. The report was signed by Roger J. Patterson on March 4, 2016.
